# fw files

> Reference of the fw files command: File manager engine from yazi: sorted listings, MIME and previewer rules, previews, copy/move/remove with progress events…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/files/

File manager engine from yazi: sorted listings, MIME and previewer rules, previews, copy/move/remove with progress events, sftp:// paths; JSON lines (runs fw-files)

## Usage

```bash
fw files <ls|mime|preview|cp|mv|rm|rules> [args]
```

## Aliases

`fw fl` runs `fw files`.

## Subcommands

```bash
fw files ls
fw files mime
fw files preview
fw files cp
fw files mv
fw files rm
fw files rules
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
